source_inventory.rule: Retain literal fragment artifact strata and original source-reference bindings. Parent families are explicit rollups.

seed_derivation: Use the sealed R3 select helper: SHA256 of canonical JSON [202610081850, fragment, artifact_sha256, FINAL-DISPOSITION, class], then Random.sample over sorted native keys with the derived integer seed. Selected keys are sorted after drawing.

pending_conflict_census.quota: ALL N; both designated families read every row
pending_conflict_census.original_action_claim_ids: Retain every closure.pending_conflict.action_side_row_ids entry and the full original row/source/fragment evidence.
pending_conflict_census.sample_exclusion: PENDING-CONFLICT rows are excluded from all sampled pools, including PENDING-PIN and PENDING-LOCATOR. They are census-only under the CC ruling 2026-10-08T23:09:31Z.

identity: Native decision_key: canonical repository_or_entry, literal slot, canonical qualification. The final read projection calls this tuple row_id.
overlap: For rows outside the PENDING-CONFLICT census, closure pin/locator flags add strata and do not replace the literal PENDING stratum. Record memberships and unique selected rows separately. A non-conflict row with both flags belongs to both flag strata.
draw_gate: Exact hash-pinned native manifest with validation.status PASS, no blockers, and validation.profile start-closure/1. Neither held-action origin completeness nor a reshape cue is required by this profile.

required_reads.each_family: Every final action row, every PENDING-CONFLICT census row, and every selected sample row, including profile code and tests; zero sample defects.

limits: Packet generation does not execute reads, establish zero defects, accept a model family, or mark G5 MET.

Held source action claims do not change the final action set. Only an explicit, validated closure.pending_conflict flag adds a row to the separate conflict census; unflagged held claims do not contribute action or sample strata. Original row and origin evidence is preserved.
The sealed R3 package and the default compact manifest validation contract stay unchanged.
